about_the_game:
Assemble your decks against various unique beasts and enemies. Each of them has its own capabilities, learn the nature and their moves and prepare your techniques to fit them



You will play as Naratha, the beast slayer who traverses along the land to find something he needs to know. In his journey, he will discover a lot of mysteries of this world, and maybe…it has to have someone to do something about it!



It’s dangerous to go alone…. Take some friends to go with you! Talee and a little white tiger cub are following Naratha, they can help in a fight too!
And you may find some more trustworthy companions to help you out on your adventure.



There are over hundreds of cards and myriad pieces of equipment waiting for you to come and master them! You can customize Naratha’s fighting deck to your liking, matching your style with bonus skills from pieces of equipment, and maybe companion cards can be the core mechanic of your deck!



The beasts of this world are enormous and powerful. Some tribes and cultures thrive from living together with those beasts in their habitat, some are hunting them, some are benefitting mutually, and some are just trying to survive from them. And the balance has been made. Until the darkness has plagued the land.

short_description: NARATHA is a story-driven RPG with deck-building gameplay. Adventure through the world as Naratha, the beast slayer. Hunting down black beasts who plagued the land, and your journey will not be alone. Talee the bard and a little white tiger cub will go along with you!
